API.actual_storage: Borrow actual 50h texture owner, current +40/+44 raw eight-byte records and valid actual 34h NativeSurfaceOwnerStorage wrappers. No replacement registry or COM owner.
API.surface_profile: Every reached source wrapper current token is D619A0. Borrow actual profile words through +3F; read current owner profile at native point, then +3C=B3D510 or +14=B3CC80 at native point. Those tokens select existing complete source providers, never numeric host calls.
API.device_argument_output: Caller seeds a distinct valid four-byte cell with incoming device bits; that same address is ppTexture. Invalid pool>3 uses the argument bits; receiver/table captured before COM. No uninitialized or null substitute.
API.surface_output: Entry seeds second distinct valid four-byte cell with captured owner bits before flags read, matching PUSH ECX at native S-4. It persists across levels. Native device cell is S+4, with return-address gap; new API exposes cell addresses and does not invent a gap data field.
API.validity: Cells disjoint from one another and actual owner/array/profile storage; all reached raw storage/COM outputs valid at native accesses. No added preflight, HRESULT gate, null repair, rollback or stable-array policy.
API.noops: Complete RET/RET4 callbacks ignore owner/device and application storage; new source calling conventions are distinct from original ABI.

read_order.release: Signed initial count; reload record base, wrapper, current wrapper profile then +3C; callback; increment DWORD index; reload signed count. Then capture owner+10 for current-table AddRef and freshly read table Release on captured object; reload owner+10 for final current-table Release and clear only after returning.
read_order.create: Seed owner scratch first. Capture flags +1C; pool 0..3 or incoming device bits; translate usage; read device argument receiver/table/+5C; then format+18, levels+14, height+2C, width+28. Pass original argument cell as output, no HRESULT branch.
read_order.creation_ownership: After CreateTexture read CURRENT owner+10, then argument output. If distinct publish output before conditional captured-new AddRef; reread argument after that AddRef. Release captured old if nonnull; reread argument after that Release. No extra reread on identity/no-callback branches. Release current temporary if nonnull, then clear argument cell after return even if callback changed it.
read_order.levels: Capture current texture then its table; load current record base/key before reading table+48. Pass same surface scratch. After GetSurfaceLevel reload record base/destination wrapper; read wrapper profile, scratch, profile+14. Bind actual source provider. Reload scratch after bind, Release current output unconditionally, increment index and reload signed count.
read_order.exceptions: No cleanup scope or retries; mutations remain at a throwing callback. Reference count and HRESULT returns do not add control-flow policies.
